title: Characterization of geometry and surface texture of AlSi10Mg laser powder bed fusion channels using X-ray computed tomography (Applied Sciences 11, 4304, 2021)

rights.attribution: Applied Sciences 11 (2021) 4304, DOI 10.3390/app11094304; author list to be taken from the article

notes: Only the abstract was read, on 2026-11-12, through the OpenAlex metadata record, which lists the licence as CC BY. The publisher site and a university repository copy both refused a scripted client; those channels are recorded as unavailable and were not bypassed. The author list was not read from the article and is left to the DOI. Abstract: LPBF AlSi10Mg channels of 1 to 9 mm nominal diameter carry process-induced dross and a surface texture that depends on the local angular position; profile parameters identify extreme dross and sintered particles; the unobstructed equivalent diameter falls along the channel length. The abstract gives no number usable here. Round channels only: nothing on rectangular passages, rib roots, fillets or corner radii.
